title: Hold a security business licence
what: Hold the state's security business (or agent) licence before providing security services, and use only licensed staff.

sources.title: Security Industry Act 1997 (NSW)
sources.publisher: Official register text via the Open Australian Legal Corpus
sources.quote: A person must not provide persons to carry on security activities unless— (a) the person is the holder of a master licence,

reach.note: Investigators are licensed under this Act only where it names them; locksmiths are not covered.

assessment.summary: A security business licence, with probity checks and training for its people, before trading.

marks.reason: A licence with probity checks is needed before trading.
Licensing requirements narrow the pool of workers who may do licensed work and the ease of moving into it.
